item.title: @seav Sharing here as I didn't know: "The barangay (...) is the smallest administrative division in the Philippines." https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barangay

Interesting article and picture gallery of what the agricultural patterns as seen from space reveal about the local practices but also the history. https://www.geographyrealm.com/types-of-agricultural-patterns-visible-from-space/ Naturally, this also reflects in the #OpenStreetMap data, when mappers diligently map individual pieces of farmland. https://overpass-turbo.eu/s/20Dt So, does it imply there could be a way to discover interesting patterns through raw data as well? Patchwork of narrow agricultural fields near Sułoszowa, PolandVisualization with Overpass-Turbo of the patchwork of pieces of farmland mapped in OpenStreetMap

Suggestions how to do this? I used to use #ehtermap (https://getethermap.org/) to do this, but it looks down these days. The idea is to let online meeting participants see a map of the world of where everyone is. Practically, they would push a pin on the map, and it would show everyone's location. #map #OpenStreetMap

Nice to see a Belgian national newspaper use #OpenStreetMap base map to illustrate their article, with some 3D buildings even: https://www.lesoir.be/610306/article/2024-07-18/festivites-du-21-juillet-laffiche-du-concert-gratuit-au-cinquantenaire-devoilee #LeSoir Map of July 21st national day celebration events in Brussels using OpenStreetMap as base map

@opencage Did you maybe already cover #Peru’s unusual sea borders in a previous #geoweirdness post? It’s not so much about the Chilean–Peruvian maritime dispute than about Peru’ sea border going much farther in the ocean than any other country. https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/288247#map=5/-9.015/-74.092 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chilean–Peruvian_maritime_dispute #maps Picture of Peru’s borders showing its sea borders are going much farther away in the ocean than any other country

OSM Teams is a tool for creating teams and roles in the #OpenStreetMap ecosystem for management of groups and communities to organize around existing tools like Tasking Manager, OSMCha, or iD, and improves collaboration. - Found or find a team: https://mapping.team/teams - Video demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GSa4IWxZz4g cc: @openstreetmap #OSMTeams Screenshot of OSM Teams

Not clear yet what the concrete benefits are, but it’s worth noting #OpenStreetMap has been registered as a “Digital Public Good” by the Digital Public Goods Alliance (#DPGA), which is a multi-stakeholder United Nations-endorsed initiative. https://blog.openstreetmap.org/2024/02/05/osm-named-as-a-digital-public-good-by-un-affiliated-agency/ #UN #UnitedNations cc: @openstreetmap

Hawa Adinani explains how contributing to #OpenStreetMap has transformed her: “We often talk about how OpenStreetMap contributes to various initiatives like disaster responses, urban planning, land use analysis, and research. However, I believe we’re not doing justice to OSM by not sharing how it has profoundly impacted our personal lives.” Read more at https://www.openstreetmap.org/user/Hawa%20Adinani/diary/402134.

#OpenStreetMap Belgium’s Mapper of the Month #MotM is @joost_schouppe. If the name sounds familiar to you, it might be for many reasons. It could be for his past involvement as OpenStreetMap Foundation #OSMF board member, for leading the Belgian community chapter, or being a very active mapper. Read the interview at https://openstreetmap.be/en/motm/2023/08/01/joost-schouppe.html. cc: @openstreetmap

Interesting paper from #MDPI about “Mapping with #ChatGPT” concludes it delivers unique advantages, such as: - lowering the barrier to producing maps - boosting the efficiency of massive map production - and understanding geographical space with its spatial thinking capability. Limitations cited are: - its unequal benefits for different users (need to have some expertise already) - and necessary user intervention for quality control. https://www.mdpi.com/2220-9964/12/7/284 cc: @openstreetmap

A nice comprehensive post explaining why State of the Map Conferences #SotM are so important to #OpenStreetMap: https://blog.openstreetmap.org/2023/07/07/why-state-of-the-map-conferences-are-so-important-to-osm/ Already attended one? Cc: @openstreetmap
